title: TurboEvolve: Towards Fast and Robust LLM-Driven Program Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2604.18607v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM-driven program evolution can discover high-quality programs, but high API cost and run-to-run variance hinder reliable progress. We propose TurboEvolve, a multi-island evolutionary framework that improves sample efficiency and stability under matched API-cost budgets. Inspired by multiple-offspring strategies in evolutionary algorithms, TurboEvolve introduces Verbalized Sampling, which elicits K diverse candidates in one LLM call while using self-assigned probabilities only as generation signals, together with an online scheduler that adapts K to expand exploration under stagnation and reduce redundant generation during steady progress. To exploit existing solution pools, TurboEvolve further introduces island-aware initialization, which clusters seed programs into mode-specific subpopulations and applies controlled cross-cluster mixing with elitist preservation to balance diversity, sharing, and refinement. translated_title: TurboEvolve：迈向快速且稳健的LLM驱动程序进化
translated_abstract: LLM驱动的程序进化能够发现高质量的程序，但高昂的API成本和每次运行之间的差异阻碍了可靠的进展。我们提出了TurboEvolve，一个多岛进化框架，在匹配的API成本预算下提升样本效率与稳定性。受进化算法中多后代策略的启发，TurboEvolve引入了言语化采样，可在一次LLM调用中引出K个多样化的候选程序，同时仅将自分配的概率用作生成信号，并结合在线调度器自适应地调整K，以便在停滞时扩大探索范围，在稳定进展时减少冗余生成。为了利用现有的解池，TurboEvolve进一步引入了岛屿感知初始化，将种子程序聚类为特定模式的子种群，并应用受控的跨集群混合与精英保留策略，以平衡多样性、共享与精炼。我们还精心整理了一个……
tldr: TurboEvolve是一种多岛进化框架，通过在一次LLM调用中生成多个多样化候选的言语化采样、自适应在线调度器以及岛屿感知初始化，在相同API成本预算下显著提升了LLM驱动程序进化的样本效率与稳定性。
en_tdlr: TurboEvolve is a multi-island evolutionary framework that improves sample efficiency and stability of LLM-driven program evolution under matched API-cost budgets via Verbalized Sampling that elicits diverse candidates in one LLM call, an adaptive online scheduler, and island-aware initialization.
